how_it_earns.line: INVENTED FIXTURE - Storage systems and their operating contracts, the whole of the business

what_is_changing.statement: INVENTED FIXTURE - Nothing about how this company earns has changed this year. It builds and operates storage systems, and revenue grew from 940 to 1180 million dollars on the same business model as last year.

GSTA.what_it_does: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Alpha assembles and operates utility-scale battery systems, and sells them to electricity utilities and independent power producers. A customer that lost Alpha would lose the software that bids its stored energy into the power market, and would have to re-contract the maintenance of a twenty-year asset.

decisive_metrics.name: Storage revenue this quarter
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: The single line this company sells. Its growth is the whole of the case.

decisive_metrics.name: Revenue against last year
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Whether the shipment rate is rising with the theme or only with one customer's build.

decisive_metrics.name: Price per kilowatt-hour shipped
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Rack makers compete on price. What each unit earns decides whether volume growth is worth anything.

how_it_earns.line: INVENTED FIXTURE - Battery racks, the whole of the business

what_is_changing.statement: INVENTED FIXTURE - Nothing about how this company earns has changed this year. It ships battery racks to integrators, and revenue grew from 760 to 890 million dollars on the same terms.

GSTB.what_it_does: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Beta makes the battery racks that go inside other companies' storage systems, and sells them to system integrators. An integrator that lost Beta would have to re-engineer its enclosure and re-run its fire certification around another maker's rack.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Alpha FY2024-FY2026 annual reports
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Alpha raised 500 million dollars of equity over three years, paid no dividend, bought back nothing, acquired one installer for 120 million dollars, and grew the share count by 11.4 percent.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Alpha FY2026 annual report and trade-body data
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Utility-scale storage integration is fragmented: Grid Storage Alpha holds 9 percent of deployed gigawatts and the largest supplier holds 15 percent. Alpha wins on the software that bids stored energy into the market. A utility that installs nothing keeps buying peak power at about 6 times the off-peak price.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Beta FY2024-FY2026 annual reports
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Beta funded itself from operations over three years, paid no dividend, bought back 60 million dollars of shares, made no acquisition, and cut the share count by 1.2 percent.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Beta FY2026 annual report and trade-body data
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid Storage Beta supplies the battery racks rather than the whole system and holds 7 percent of the racks shipped, against 22 percent for the largest cell maker. It wins on delivery time, quoted at 14 weeks against an industry 30. A developer that waits keeps paying grid connection charges with no revenue against them.
